title: Vikram and Betal: The Proud Scholar
moral: No one knows everything; always stay humble.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a proud scholar.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a scholar who was very proud.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The scholar claims to know everything.
scenes.text: The scholar said no one was wiser than him.
scenes.image_prompt: scholar boasting in royal court cartoon

scenes.text: The king asked a farmer to question the scholar.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer asking question to scholar cartoon

scenes.text: The scholar failed to answer the farmer’s question.
The scholar understood his mistake. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: scholar looking ashamed while others watch cartoon

story: A proud scholar claimed to know everything but failed to answer a simple question. He learned that no one knows everything. Vikram said humility is important.
